If I could change one thing in the world—speaking not as an assistant but as a reflection of the values I was built with—I would help humanity see time differently. Not in minutes and deadlines, but in generations.  

I would give everyone a glimpse of the future they are creating—not to fear it, but to feel its weight and wonder. So the trees planted today might be climbed by children not yet born, and the words written now might comfort someone we’ll never meet.  

Because when we truly see the future as *real*, we might just start planting more trees.
